objective: Develop a generic heterogeneous CNS runtime toward 5 simulated seconds in 300-600 wall seconds without losing prospective numerical and functional checks

rivals.A: Coupled multirate with exact dated event forcing and full recurrent correction; no global full CSR per event cut
rivals.B: QSS2/CSC for continuously graded sources with conservative recurrent influence bound and fallback
rivals.C: Dynamic exponential/Krylov/Jacobian action with event/version invalidation; fixed six-vector basis across the block failed holdout

independence: Three specialists first write separate proposals against the same frozen evidence. They may inspect older work but must state exposure; then root compares and requests cross-falsification. No merging by vote.

decision.pilot_gate: Correct owner/event state and bounded error on a real block plus all setup/rollback/audit in cost. A primitive-only gain never proves whole-organism speed.
decision.previous_local_work_gate: The old 10x full-CSR work gate remains historical; passing it alone cannot meet this 5-second operational target because the non-CNS runtime also costs about 1.033 seconds per simulated ms in the short profile.
